intro: This library is reviewed against primary sources, not secondary summaries. 10 changes in the last ninety days, from the state bill tracker and the framework explainers, newest first.

items.body: The OMB memorandum governing federal agency AI adoption. Compliance plans, Chief AI Officers, public use case inventories, and high-impact determinations.
items.headline: OMB M-25-21 and Federal Agency AI Governance

items.body: The FTC compulsory-process study of generative AI companion products. 23 specifications on monetisation, age limits, safety testing, and data.
items.headline: FTC 6(b) Study of AI Companions

items.body: On July 13, 2026, the Department of War suspended CMMC Phase II. DFARS 252.204-7012, NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2, and Phase I self-assessment still bind. The verification was cut; the obligation was not. This is the third jurisdiction in fourteen months to make that trade.
items.headline: Federal Contractor AI

items.body: A read of the published DOJ AI use case inventory: what is deployed, what is high-impact, which vendors, and the state of the required safeguards.
items.headline: The DOJ AI Use Case Inventory

items.body: The Consumer Financial Protection Bureau's AI enforcement covering credit, lending, and financial products.
items.headline: CFPB AI Enforcement

items.body: The January 2026 memorandum directing an AI-first Department. Seven Pace-Setting Projects, and procurement criteria aimed at model alignment and usage policies.
items.headline: The Department of War AI Strategy

items.body: HITRUST CSF is a certifiable security framework from HITRUST, a private standards body. It underlies three certifications, e1, i1 and r2, and since late 2024 an AI Security Certification for deployed AI systems. It is not a law and HIPAA does not require it.
items.headline: HITRUST CSF

items.body: FedRAMP is the General Services Administration program that sets one standard way to assess the security of cloud services for federal agencies. Its AI Prioritization Initiative ran from August 2025 to April 2026 and ended with three AI services certified. The program is now moving to FedRAMP 20x.
items.headline: FedRAMP and AI

items.body: How the Fair Credit Reporting Act governs AI that produces consumer reports. Accuracy, adverse action notices, dispute rights.
items.headline: FCRA and AI

items.body: How the Gramm-Leach-Bliley Act governs AI at financial institutions. Safeguards Rule, Privacy Rule, third-party oversight.
items.headline: GLBA and AI
